entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah... yes, I... I need to return something. My VeloBand. I'm just so lost with all this, the website was confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
Of course. It's Maria Garcia, order number VF77819-B. I just... I don't even know if I can return it. It's been a while.

Thank you, Maria. I'm pulling up your account now... I see you received the VeloBand GPS Tracker 38 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... we had a family emergency right after it arrived. My husband had to have an unexpected surgery, and he was in the hospital for weeks. I never even opened the box. It's been the last thing on my mind. Can't you just help me?
I am so sorry to hear about your husband's health. I hope he is recovering well. It's completely understandable that this wasn't a priority. Let me just check the return policy for you.
Thank you. I appreciate that. I just feel so overwhelmed by it all.

Okay Maria, I've checked our system. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery. Since you received it 38 days ago, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe to send it back for a full refund.
Oh, really? It's that simple? That's such a relief. I was so worried I had missed my chance.

Not at all, you're perfectly fine. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow. Thank you, Sarah. You've been a huge help. I was so stressed about this.
You're very welcome, Maria. We'll process your refund as soon as we receive the item. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a speedy recovery. Have a good day.
